# @fyit/crouton-themes

> Swappable UI themes for Nuxt UI — KO, Minimal, KR-11, and Black & White themes with theme switcher

## Components

- `KoButton`: Full tactile button with LED slot
- `KoDisplay`: 7-segment style LED readout
- `KoKnob`: Rotary knob control with drag interaction
- `KoLabel`: Hardware-style engraved label
- `KoLed`: LED indicator with glow animations (off, on, blink, fast, alive)
- `KoPanel`: Hardware-inspired display panel with glass overlay
- `KoPunchHole`: Decorative punch hole element
- `KoSpeakerGrill`: Speaker grill pattern element
- `KrDisplay`: 7-segment LED tempo display with blink animation
- `KrKnob`: Rotary control with drag interaction
- `KrLed`: Status LED indicator (yellow, green, with blink)
- `KrPad`: Tactile drum pad button (cream, coral, gold, mint)
- `KrSpeakerGrill`: Horizontal slot speaker grill pattern
- `ThemeCompactPicker`: Compact theme picker for settings panels
- `ThemeSwitcher`: Theme selector with dropdown, inline, or cycle mode

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useThemeMenuItems`
- `useThemeSwitcher`
